description: Reads the teleprompter state of one webinar: whether the prompter is switched on for this install, the script the host reads out loud (with its trigger lines such as [TRIGGER:CTA "..."]), and the language it is written in. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks whether a script exists, wants to read it, or wants a new one (that is wi_write_webinar_prompter). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

name: wi_get_webinar_prompter
title: Read the teleprompter script
